text:
Mia L: hey @people-ops — quick q. I'm in the middle of an adoption process and the placement date is uncertain. how do notice, paperwork, and coverage planning work if the start date can move around? thanks!
Taylor (Benefits): congrats, Mia! for adoption leave you can start on the placement date. recommend filing our adoption_leave_form as soon as you have a tentative window so we can pre-authorize payroll and benefits. ideally 30 days notice but we can handle shorter.
Samir R: curious — if placement shifts last-minute, can we update the start date without breaking benefits/top-up?
Taylor (Benefits): Yes — you can update. when you change dates, re-submit the form and mark "flex_start: yes". Payroll needs at least 48h to avoid manual retro adjustments but we can process urgent changes.
Jordan (Payroll): payroll note: we use code ADOPT_PAY for salary continuation. when dates change within payroll cutoff (Fri 15:00 PT) it's seamless; changes after cutoff will require a retro. send updates to payroll@redwood.com and cc your manager.
Leah P: Mia — for coverage let's list 2 owners for core tasks and a short runbook. happy to pick up product review and oncall if needed.
Mia L: thanks! i'll draft a 1-pager and invite Leah for a 15m handover.
Taylor (Benefits): paperwork checklist link: https://intranet.redwood/hr/adoption-leave. quick form snippet:
```
adoption_leave_form
- name:
- placement_date (tentative):
- expected_end_date:
- flex_start: yes/no
- supporting_docs: upload
- manager_coverage_contacts:
```
Taylor (Benefits): also note parental top-up (company policy) applies for full-time employees up to 12 weeks. benefits counselor (benefits@redwood.com) can confirm eligibility and state-specific rules.
Samir R: for international hires — does policy differ? my partner in EU asked about local statutory vs company top-up.
Taylor (Benefits): yes, local laws can change entitlement. we follow local statutory leave first, then company top-up where applicable. benefits counselor will run the calc for EU cases.
hr-bot: Request created: ADOPT-1785004321. A benefits rep will reach out within 2 business days.
Mia L: perfect — appreciate the fast replies. I'll submit the form now and ping here when it's updated. :wave:
